messages.content: Emily earned 180 points during her freshman year on the school volleyball team. She earned 15% more points during her sophomore year. How many points did she earn during both years?

Emily earned 180 points during her freshman year.
She earned 15% more points during her sophomore year.
15% of 180 points is $180 * 15 / 100 = 2700 / 100 = 27$.
So she earned $180 + 27 = 207$ points during her sophomore year.
Thus, the total points she earned in both years is $180 + 207 = 387$.
So Emily earned \boxed{387} points during both years.
